title: Ed-Fi Certification Scenario Config
description: Per-scenario metadata for collections whose scenarios span several entities (MTSS). Read by bruno/scripts/lib/scenario-lint.cjs and, per AC-665/AC-666, by the Admin App catalog and runner.

option.description: A choice within an option group. A vendor completes exactly one choice per group.

choice.description: Choice number; matches [OPTION N] in names.

option.description: The whole scenario belongs to this choice.

provides.description: Runtime variables this scenario produces for other scenarios.

needs.description: Variables borrowed from other scenarios' capturedVars in the same certification run. The source scenario's value wins on restore.

steps.description: Per-step markers keyed by step file name.

option.description: The step is required only when this choice is taken.
